title: WorkerItem (WorkItem)
description: One entry of the durable readiness index: what a worker is due to work on. Rust: crates/agentscope-durable/src/store.rs::WorkItem; the persisted record is store/file.rs::WorkRecord (#[serde(rename_all = camelCase)] on workId/readyAt). Ordering is by readiness, and `ready_at < 0` removes the entry.

queue.description: Queue name. The turn queue is keyed by harness selector, so one store can serve several definitions.

workId.description: Identity of the work item inside its queue (a thread id for the turn queue).

readyAt.description: Epoch millis on the store clock. A worker may only claim the item once now >= readyAt; a negative value marks the entry for removal.

payload.description: Opaque scheduling payload; absent when the queue stores none.
